question:
Case Study:

The equation $ax + by + cz = d$ is satisfied by three points $P:(1,1,1)$, $Q:(2,3,4)$, $R:(2,-1,2)$. Formulate the determinant to find the value of $d$ in terms of $a, b, c$.
explanation:
Substitute each point:

For $P$, $a + b + c = d$ (1)

For $Q$, $2a + 3b + 4c = d$ (2)

For $R$, $2a - b + 2c = d$ (3)

Write the homogeneous system for $a,b,c$:

$\begin{pmatrix}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 2 & -1 & 2\end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix}a \\ b \\ c\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}d \\ d \\ d\end{pmatrix}$

To have nontrivial solution, set the determinant of the $3\times3$ matrix equal to zero:

$\begin{vmatrix}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 2 & -1 & 2\end{vmatrix} = 0$

Expand:

$= 1\begin{vmatrix}3 & 4 \\ -1 & 2\end{vmatrix} - 1\begin{vmatrix}2 & 4 \\ 2 & 2\end{vmatrix} + 1\begin{vmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 2 & -1\end{vmatrix}$

First minor: $3\times2-4\times(-1)=6+4=10$

Second: $2\times2-4\times2=4-8=-4$

Third: $2\times(-1)-3\times2=-2-6=-8$

$= 1 \times 10 - 1 \times (-4) + 1 \times (-8) = 10 + 4 - 8 = 6$

So unless $a,b,c$ are proportional (determinant is nonzero), $d$ must equal as per any row: $d = a + b + c$.
